definitions.eek: used to express alarm or surprise.
definitions.eke: make something last longer by using or consuming it frugally.
definitions.eon: an indefinite and very long period.
definitions.eye: the organ of sight in humans or other animals.
definitions.ken: one's range of knowledge or sight.
definitions.ketone: an organic compound containing a carbonyl group ═C═O bonded to two alkyl groups, e.g. acetone.
definitions.key: a small piece of shaped metal with incisions cut to fit the wards of a particular lock, which is inserted into the lock and rotated to open or close it or to operate a switch.
definitions.keynote: a prevailing tone or central theme.
definitions.knee: the joint between the thigh and the lower leg.
definitions.net: a piece of open-meshed material used typically for catching fish.
definitions.note: a brief written record of facts, topics, or thoughts, used as an aid to memory.
definitions.one: the lowest cardinal number; half of two; 1. (Roman numeral: i or I.).
definitions.tee: a cleared space on a golf course, from which the ball is struck at the beginning of play for each hole.
definitions.ten: equivalent to the product of five and two; one more than nine; 10.
definitions.toe: any of the five digits at the end of the human foot.
definitions.toke: a pull on a cigarette or pipe, typically one containing cannabis.
definitions.token: a thing serving to represent a fact, quality, feeling, etc.
definitions.tone: a musical or vocal sound with reference to its pitch, quality, and strength.
definitions.tyke: a small child, especially a mischievous one.
definitions.yen: the basic monetary unit of Japan.
definitions.yet: up until the present or a specified or implied time; by now or then.
definitions.yoke: a wooden crosspiece that is fastened over the necks of two animals and attached to a plough or cart that they pull in unison.
